perks.name: Heal Clip
perks.desc: Reloading shortly after dealing a final blow grants Cure to you and your nearby allies.

perks.name: Recycled Energy
perks.desc: Reloading after defeating targets grants energy to your lowest charged ability.

perks.name: Rapid Hit
perks.desc: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed.

perks.name: Lone Wolf
perks.desc: Slightly improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

perks.name: To the Pain
perks.desc:
While this weapon is equipped, taking damage increases handling and aim assist until the weapon is stowed.

Taking more damage increases the effect.

perks.name: Keep Away
perks.desc: Increases reload, range, and accuracy when no targets are in close proximity.

perks.name: Repulsor Brace
perks.desc: Defeating a Void-debuffed target grants an overshield.

perks.name: Kill Clip
perks.desc: Reloading after a kill grants increased damage.

perks.name: Incandescent
perks.desc:
Defeating a target spreads scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

perks.name: Closing Time
perks.desc: Improves range, accuracy, and handling as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Precision Instrument
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage increases precision damage.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.desc: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Elemental Honing
perks.desc: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Withering Gaze
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon for a short period of time without firing grants the ability to weaken the next target. Timer resets after firing or when you stop aiming down sights.

perks.name: Demoralize
perks.desc: Precision final blows cause nearby targets to become weakened.

perks.name: Häkke Breach Armaments
perks.desc:
This weapon deals increased damage against vehicles and constructs.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 136 from 1 April 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/6I828LxsIqdth4iIlSYRmG?si=8022df8ede664223) with @CourtProjects, @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-MajorSpec PvE-Champion PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for piercing Barrier Champions in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content, particularly with void builds. Admetus-D is a rare energy Häkke weapon - a void scout rifle with the High-Impact frame intrinsic of ×0.8 accuracy cone size and ×0.83 accuracy cone growth when you're stationary or moving less than 2.8m/s, for easier crits and hits. At base, by comparison with its peers, the stats are good - 65 Range equates to 80.88m ADS and 40.44m hipfire before damage dropoff, 29 Stability is ×1.1202 flinch resist at 100 Resilience, 30 Handling is 0.45s ready, 0.36s ADS and 0.44s stow speed, 35 Reload Speed is a 2.27s reload, Recoil Direction is 76, Zoom is 21, and magazine size is 14 (max 20). Handling is the stat that needs the most TLC, so that's the top choice for the barrel perks. Then, for a stick-it-in-your-vault for when the artifact mod is around, the combination of Armor-Piercing Rounds for ×1.05 damage to shields and barriers, together with Repulsor Brace for a void overshield for killing void debuffed targets and Withering Gaze to apply 15% weaken for an effective ×1.176 damage boost for 6s for your whole fireteam should make short work of Barrier Champions. If you're interested, Admetus means "untamed" and was the king of Pherae in Thessaly, Ancient Greece, who was saved by Apollo from his fated death when his wife Alcestis offered to die in his place. The Häkke Breach Armaments origin trait is situationally useful, passively boosting damage against vehicles (×1.15), constructs (×1.3) and stasis crystals (×1.45). Recommended MW: Reload Speed or Handling, with a Backup Mag mod or, when masterworked, Synergy to create Void Breaches or, when the artifact mod's around, Stunloader. Also, don't forget to check whether there's a useful Seasonal Fragile mod for the activity you're running.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "There's not a lot that needs to be said about Admetus-D. It has a great reload perk in Rapid Hit, paired with an equally good damage perk in Precision Instrument. Or you can opt for Repulsor Brace and Withering Gaze for Void synergy. Then you could also go for a general purpose scout with Recycled Energy being a nice new perk to top off your ability charges." Recommended MW: Handling.
